name: Kyogre (CobbleEffort form)
look: a giant mud fish: a broad mud-brown whale body with a khaki belly, a back caked in cracked dried mud, glowing ochre veins along its flanks and fins, a flat catfish head with drooping barbels, mudskipper eyes bulging on top, great pectoral fins it walks on and four tail flukes
entry: It sleeps for centuries buried in the mud of the great swamps. When it wakes, its rains turn the land to mire, and it drags itself through the mud it made on its great fins, its veins glowing.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in swamps and mangroves, only while it rains.
